effects.text: Facilities (R. Patterson): mains are off for the night. Generator 2 runs the mainframe. GEARGR~1.EXE on your desktop. Throttle's stuck open, so it's all clutch and gears. Don't let it stall.

you're sitting at my desk.

GENSET.CFG found in C_DRIVE. Bit Rot detected.
the shift log. it isn't a backup. give it its name back.
